args.title: Update BASE_URL in src/notifications/templates.ts to use the production URL
args.body: Issue 4201 reports that the password reset email contains a link to the localhost URL. The code in src/notifications/templates.ts sets the BASE_URL to `http://localhost:3000` by default when `process.env.PUBLIC_URL` is not defined. This change updates the BASE_URL to use a production URL instead, ensuring that the reset password link in the email directs users to the correct site.
